title: CFL-aware edge design for graph neural solvers of hyperbolic transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.33769v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) transport information at finite speed along characteristics, often producing shocks and discontinuities that are challenging to capture numerically. Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer learned update rules, but neighbor aggregation alone does not tell a GNN how far information must travel and along which edge. As a result, when a GNN model takes a time step larger than what was used in training, shock fronts smear and oscillations grow. In this work, we ask whether making the scale of transport explicit as an edge-local Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) signal can enhance GNNs' ability to model hyperbolic PDEs. Holding the architecture fixed, we vary only the information given to each edge, from a raw edge form to forms that progressively expose the edge-local transport interaction through direction, length, and wave speed. translated_title: 面向双曲输运图神经求解器的CFL感知边设计
translated_abstract: 双曲偏微分方程（PDE）以有限速度沿特征线输运信息，常产生激波和不连续现象，这些在数值上难以捕捉。图神经网络（GNN）提供了可学习的更新规则，但仅靠邻居聚合并不能告诉GNN信息需要传播多远以及沿哪条边传播。因此，当GNN模型采用比训练时更大的时间步长时，激波前沿会变得模糊，振荡也会增长。在这项工作中，我们探讨将输运尺度显式表示为边局部的库朗-弗里德里希斯-列维（CFL）信号是否能增强GNN建模双曲PDE的能力。在保持架构固定的情况下，我们仅改变提供给每条边的信息，从原始边形式到通过方向、长度和波速逐步揭示边局部输运相互作用的形式。由于所有这些都是由相同的要素计算得出的……
tldr: 该研究发现通过在图神经网络的边上引入显式的边局部CFL信号（涵盖方向、长度和波速等输运相互作用信息），能够显著提升GNN对双曲偏微分方程中激波和不连续现象的建模能力，即使在采用比训练时更大的时间步长时也能保持稳定。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that explicitly encoding edge-local CFL signals—exposing direction, length, and wave speed interactions—to graph neural networks significantly enhances their ability to model shocks and discontinuities in hyperbolic PDEs, maintaining stability even with time steps larger than those used in training.
